review:
I first found Hustle Cat through PressHeartToContinue and Octopimp's playthrough in 2016. Whenever I play through the game again, it's their voices I hear in my head over the brilliantly done soundtrack. (And the "NERD ALERT" whenever Graves appears.) Over the past decade, at least four laptops, and a degree, I keep coming back to this game. For me, of course, it's endlessly nostalgic, but I think even for new players it still has things to offer. The story is charming, the characters are dynamic, and the artwork is breathtaking. Part of me hopes we'll get another game like this from DateNighto, but I think the magic of Hustle Cat probably can't be replicated. Hustle Cat has been a comfort and an escape for me for years, and as someone who has been playing Otome games for over a decade, remains the standard to which I hold other games.

Happy tenth anniversary, Hustle Cat! <3

They're all so stinking cute. Not to mention the camaraderie really feels somewhat natural, because of the wittiness of the dialogue. It flows so well. The only complaint is that it is a little short for my likings. The story feels unfinished somehow, even though it isn't really. I want to spend more time in this world, I want to get answers to questions that don't get answered fully, and I wish that I could find out what the devs planned for the route they never got to write, from their kickstarter goals. I'm so curious I could tear myself apart. But yeah, instead of doing so, I will swaddle myself in the comfort this game gives me, despite its flaws. Somehow it doesn't surprise me that one of my favourite visual novels is about a magical cat cafe. It's quite literally all of the things I dream about. So yeah! Definitely check it out for sure. The Cat’s Paw is the most happening cat cafe in town and you are its newest employee. However something strange is brewing at the cafe…a mystery with a side of romance ☕

[h2][u]The Story[/u][/h2]

You play as Avery Grey and are the newest employee at the popular cat cafe called The Cat’s Paw (very clever name by the way)! You find a strange book in the basement of the cafe one day with strange letters and symbols you can’t understand. 

There are 5 potential romances; Reese, Finley, Hays, Landry and Mason. Also a secret ending but only unlockable once you’ve completed all the other routes. No worries, there are guides available to help you out. 

Life is pretty sweet being surrounded by all these handsome & beautiful potentials [i]and[/i] adorable cats! 

🌶️ Spice Level - Very mild. This game is more about romance and caring. No graphic pics or nudity. 

[h2][u]Settings, Features & Gameplay[/u][/h2]

Settings & features include; audio controls and the ability to turn on/off the scroll wheel to use it for progress. The settings truthfully are pretty limited. However there is a huge gallery that unlocks as you play. In-game you can skip text, save and view the history log.

[i] Sadly this game does not support Steam overlay or screen capture. There is a gallery to enjoy but  you will have to use alternate methods if you wish to take screen captures.[/i]

[h2][u]The Visuals & Audio[/u][/h2]

I really like the art style in this game, both the character art and the backgrounds are hand-drawn which I truly enjoy and appreciate. The sprites do have facial animations and sometimes do change poses. 

A wallpaper artwork I made to showcase artwork from the game as the game does not support Steam Overlay. All artwork is credited to the Hustle Cat game. ✨

https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3446195112

The soundtrack is mainly instrumental with laid back lo-fi tracks mixed with more upbeat tunes for parts. There are some ambient sounds added which always is a nice touch to give a bit more immersion to the story. This novel also has no voice acting. 

* I do have to say I LOVE the opening trailer after the prologue, a very catchy tune with some great editing. I very much enjoyed it. If you wish to see it check out the trailer on the store page (it is the same one). 

[h2][u]Overall Experience[/u][/h2]

I think the writing in this novel is really well done, there is some character development and the tone and use of language is fluid. The cast of characters all care about one another and you can feel that. There is also some humour thrown in which I found amusing. 

The game with all endings netted me around 8 hours. I enjoyed all the routes but my favorite was the secret romance (you need to finish all the others before you can unlock it). The gallery is chocked full of great artwork too. There are no choices in settings for what text you can skip or text speed but just a note that skipping text will stop at [i]all choices[/i].

I got this novel during the Spring sale for an insanely good price and really enjoyed my time with it. A great add-on to throw in your basket! 🐱

Hustle Cat is an LGBTQ+ Visual Novel/Dating Sim about people and cats.

You are jobless and living at your Aunt's place and one day you find yourself in front of a place named A Cat's Paw. It is a cat cafe that you soon learn is a lot more than just a mere cat cafe. This game is filled with romance, cheesy puns, humour, drama and of course, dating! Every routes starts the same but at a certain point based on your choices, you will be locked to a character's route and spend a lot more time with them.

The graphics are very well made, the avatars are nicely drawn and the cats are super cute. The music is good for it's genre and is actually composed for this game. The game's length is fair, 7-10 hours if you do all routes (I'm a fast reader, so your mileage might vary.) The writing is insanely well thought and cohesive, I don't think I've seen a single grammatical mistake during the entire game. The story is compelling and the plot twists are good, even if by now I can see most of them are coming. The game has a lot of jokes/memes/references as well!

The game has 7 main characters: Avery (main character/you, lazy, jobless, not particularly skilled at anything, nerd), Landry (friendly, reckless, protector), Hayes (shy, timid, nice), Finley (nerd, princess, famous), Mason (strong lady, protector, cold), Reese (Brat, bossy) and Graves (GOTH DADDY?) Jokes aside for the last one, I hope this helps put a picture on the variety of the cast present in this game!

Honestly I think everything in this game is perfect, aside from the game's engine itself. Saving and loading doesn't really help you there, because your choices affects which routes you will end up on, so it's just... annoying.

Overall, expensive but worth it. Good visual novel, great characters personalities and a lot of content crammed up in one game!

A very cozy VN dating sim that gives the expected warmth a cat cafe story would provide, but with even more depth than I had anticipated going in. There are some nice options for pronouns and player character appearance, so this game can be enjoyed no matter your identity.

Some gripes:
The skip button is slow. It slows down every time a new bg/cg is loaded or when there's a vfx playing. You have to click the skip button again after every choice. If there's new dialogue that you haven't seen yet, the skip button will slow down but stay activated and keep going without waiting for your input. And the skip button sometimes glitches out and doesn't work, period, causing me to have to reload the game.

The game has crashed on me about 3 times.

Also, there's no quit button as far as I know? I had to go into the options menu and uncheck the fullscreen option to be able to press the x of the game window every time I wanted to exit the game. I may have just missed it though.

The lack of any sfx was also noticeable.

But overall, despite my gripes, the story and art come first in a VN and this one absolutely delivered on it's promises. If you're looking for a cute and cozy game that you can relax to after a day's work, this is it. 

Graves is the best btw.

Впрочем, обойдемся без лишних сюжетных спойлеров. Итак, Hustle Cat. Визуальная новелла в самом традиционном виде и понимании. В нашем распоряжении - главный герой-подросток, который, вдоволь навалявшись на диване, решает все-таки найти себе работу, и в итоге находит... приключений на свой еще не отшлепанный жизнью зaд.   

Повествование ведется от первого лица - Эвери знакомится с работниками кафе, ведет различные диалоги, с кем-то сближается, с кем-то враждует, попутно пытаясь вызнать как можно больше о самом кафе и его тайнах. 

В сюжете понамешали всего - тут вам и мистика, и драма, и романтика, и магия, и много чего еще. Насколько все это органично смотрится вместе, судить сложно: отдельные моменты меня зацепили, многое, наоборот, показалось лишним и избыточным. Одно могу сказать совершенно однозначно - игру нужно проходить несколько раз, чтобы понять все происходящее до конца. Причем, ветку "Грейвса" лучше либо пройти самой первой, если хотите сразу понять суть основного сюжета, либо, наоборот, оставить её на сладкое, потому что именно в ней вы получите ответы на большую часть возникающих вопросов. 

В зависимости от принимаемых решений, у нашего героя обязательно завяжутся отношения с одним из коллег. Общая канва истории будет неизменна, отличается именно середина, в которой Вы строите отношения с выбранным Вами персонажем. Так что по сути, Hustle Cat - эдакий симулятор свиданий, в который подмешали чуть драмы и волшебства под видом общей сюжетки. 

Рисовка и общая графическая составляющая в Hustle Cat весьма сносная. Музыка поначалу вызвала неприятие (если честно, главная тема мне до сих пор жутко не нравится), но остальные композиции к моменту пятого перепрохождения даже как-то понравились. Или это своего рода стокгольмский синдром? В игре имеется набор несложных, но затратных по времени достижений, большая часть которых завязана на полученных Вами концовках. Также представлен неплохой инструментарий - текст можно перемотать, сохранить и в целом все вполне читабельно и понятно. Если знаешь английский, разумеется.

This is one of those little gems that you can play over the course of two or three days, put down for a while, and come back some time later to enjoy all the whimsy and delight it brings you. I forgot about this game for a couple of years until I saw I had the theme song saved on YouTube, which instantly reminded me of how much I had loved the game before... Next thing you know, I'm replaying all the routes again. While it's not the kind of game I could play every day (much like I wouldn't want to read the same book every day), it's the kind that I can come back to after a while, having forgotten many of the details, and be surprised and delighted even if I remember the overall gist of a particular route. I would recommend to anyone who enjoys a lighthearted dating sim with just enough bite to keep it interesting.

First big pro is the gender options of both the MC as well as LI routes. It had a compelling plot and likable characters. There are some emotional beats in some routes that can tug at your heartstrings. I also enjoy the fact that both the LI's and the MC go through character development throughout the game. However I would suggest waiting for the game to go on sale before purchasing. It is much too short to be worth it's current price.
